details:
This issue I have raised Previously this issue in an older canny due to the danger this poses to Adults and Minors.

Post:

https://feedback.vrchat.com/age-verification/p/age-verification-checkmark-potentially-harmful-for-users-personal-safety

In my previous canny I mentioned the "Shield" icon still displays if you are verified or not, The user has the option to hide their 18+ badge or keep it.

Now the new UI Update has come Where Adults and Minors have the Identical badge, I.e This increases the chance someone thinks they are talking to an adult rather then a minor, causing this default cycle where people assume the current badge icon applies to all adults and adults only which, (Is currently not the case in the OB build (Please Seriously consider this before releasing))

This issue going this Unattended says something is seriously wrong (Previous and positionally this one too). 

I hold true to my Original canny and state If a user doesn't have their 18+ Badge, Get rid of the Icon on the nameplate banner also.

If you're an everyday VRChatter you don't look at peoples Bios (maybe thats just me), You just Chat and don't look, Sure you peek at the nameplates to know their name since you hide them, You see that badge, Ah I'm talking to an adult, That can be pretty misleading.

Please, For the protection and security of Adults and minors, Remove this Icon from the bar if the account is NOT 18+ (or verified at all) (I strongly believe any 18+ user should be barred from hiding their badge)

Long to short:

Minors display the same 18+ verification badge even though they are not 18+ Verified.

[I have redacted the details of the account to protect the person(s) at hand]
title: [1879] 18+ Verified Badge conflicts with minors
